label: <button type="button" class="btn" style="margin-left:5px; transition: all 0.2s; display:inline-block;" onclick="event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();try{var ta=document.getElementById('simple_message')||document.querySelector('textarea');if(!ta||!ta.value){UI.ErrorMessage('❗ Brak danych',2000);return false;}if(!this.dataset.copied){var txt=ta.value;var btn=this;navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(function(){UI.SuccessMessage('📋 Skopiowano!',2000);btn.dataset.copied='true';btn.innerHTML='✅ Otwórz Bazę';btn.style.setProperty('background','linear-gradient(#5cad5c 0%, #2e7a2e 30%, #1f5c1f 80%, #0f2e0f 100%)','important');}).catch(function(e){UI.ErrorMessage('⚠️ Błąd kopiowania',2000);});}else{this.dataset.copied='';this.innerHTML='📋 Eksportuj';this.style.background='';window.open('https://twdatabase.online/attacks','_blank','noopener,noreferrer');}return false;}catch(err){UI.ErrorMessage('❗ Błąd: '+err.message,2500);return false;}">📋 Eksportuj</button>
